title: Selene Hub |
features:
🌙 Selene Hub | War Tycoon 🌙

Dominate War Tycoon with Selene Hub! Built with a sleek, dark-themed Rayfield UI, this script is packed with everything you need to automate your tycoon and win every battle.

🔥 Key Features:
• Automations: Collect Cash, Auto Build, and Oil Extractor.
• Teleports & Items: Get Oil Barrels, Get Airdrops, Tp to Capture Point, and Tp to Tycoon.
• Combat & Misc: Infinite Ammo, Hitbox Expander, No Fall Damage, Infinite Jump, and Player ESP.

🔑 How to use the Key System:
1. Execute the script.
2. Click the "Get Key" button (this copies the Linkvertise link to your clipboard).
3. Paste the link in your browser, complete the short steps, and copy the key provided.
4. Paste the key back into the Roblox prompt and hit enter!
